items.text: Chest pain or pressure, or pain spreading to arm, jaw or back
Face drooping, arm weakness or slurred speech (stroke signs)
Fainting, a seizure for the first time, or confusion
Vomiting blood, black stools or heavy bleeding
Severe abdominal pain, or a rigid swollen belly
High fever with stiff neck, rash that does not fade, or fever over 3 days
Thoughts of harming yourself or ending your life
Pregnant with bleeding, severe pain or reduced baby movements
Sudden loss of vision, or a severe sudden headache unlike any before
